queries.name: schema
rows:
CREATE TABLE `ctx_doc` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `kind` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `path` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `line_start` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `line_end` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `symbol` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_doc` (`path`, `line_start`) BLOCK_SIZE 16384 LOCAL,
  KEY `idx_kind` (`kind`) BLOCK_SIZE 16384 LOCAL,
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_body` (`body`) WITH PARSER ik PARSER_PROPERTIES=(ik_mode="smart") BLOCK_SIZE 16384
) ORGANIZATION INDEX AUTO_INCREMENT = 1000956 DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0

queries.name: counts_by_kind
queries.sql: SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS chunks FROM ctx_doc GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

queries.name: retrieval_specs
queries.sql: SELECT kind, CONCAT(path, ':', line_start, '-', line_end) AS citation, ROUND(MATCH(body) AGAINST('REQ-ORD-006 筛选 状态'), 4) AS score FROM ctx_doc WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST('REQ-ORD-006 筛选 状态') AND kind IN ('spec') ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: retrieval_code
queries.sql: SELECT kind, CONCAT(path, ':', line_start, '-', line_end) AS citation, ROUND(MATCH(body) AGAINST('list_orders parse_pagination status created_after min_amount'), 4) AS score FROM ctx_doc WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST('list_orders parse_pagination status created_after min_amount') AND kind = 'code' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

queries.name: retrieval_tests
queries.sql: SELECT kind, CONCAT(path, ':', line_start, '-', line_end) AS citation, ROUND(MATCH(body) AGAINST('test_filter_by_status test_filters_compose test_filter_by_min_amount'), 4) AS score FROM ctx_doc WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST('test_filter_by_status test_filters_compose test_filter_by_min_amount') AND kind = 'test' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

queries.name: retrieval_all_kinds
queries.sql: SELECT kind, citation, score FROM (  (SELECT kind, CONCAT(path, ':', line_start, '-', line_end) AS citation,      ROUND(MATCH(body) AGAINST('筛选 状态 时间范围 金额下限'), 4) AS score    FROM ctx_doc WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST('筛选 状态 时间范围 金额下限')    AND kind = 'spec' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 2)   UNION ALL   (SELECT kind, CONCAT(path, ':', line_start, '-', line_end) AS citation,      ROUND(MATCH(body) AGAINST('list_orders parse_pagination status created_after min_amount'), 4) AS score    FROM ctx_doc WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST('list_orders parse_pagination status created_after min_amount')    AND kind = 'code' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 2)   UNION ALL   (SELECT kind, CONCAT(path, ':', line_start, '-', line_end) AS citation,      ROUND(MATCH(body) AGAINST('test_filter_by_status test_filters_compose test_filter_by_min_amount'), 4) AS score    FROM ctx_doc WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST('test_filter_by_status test_filters_compose test_filter_by_min_amount')    AND kind = 'test' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 2) ) AS merged ORDER BY kind, score DESC
